description: This Java interface defines an EventAdapter that maps Event objects to an Adaptable interface within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It specifies criteria and actions related to event topics.

classes.name: EventAdapter
classes.description: A generic interface extending Adapter that maps Event objects to an Adaptable, specifying criteria and actions related to event management within the protocol.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the criteria set for the EventAdapter, specifically indicating it handles EVENT type topics.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions (CREATED, MODIFIED, DELETED) that this EventAdapter can handle.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is intended for responses; returns false by default.
